duplicate.subject: Your order {order ID}: it was already sent
duplicate.message:
Hello {name},

This is about your order {order ID} for {product}.

The same order, screenshot or review was already sent for another entry.

If this is a mistake, please reply to this email and tell us.

{sign-off}

orderShotMissing.subject: Your order {order ID}: please send the purchase screenshot
orderShotMissing.message:
Hello {name},

This is about your order {order ID} for {product}.

The purchase screenshot was not added in the form, so we cannot see the order.

Please reply to this email with the purchase screenshot: a screenshot of this order on Amazon that shows the order ID, the amount and the product.

How to take it:
In the Amazon app: tap "You", then "Your Orders", then this order.
On the Amazon website: click "Returns & Orders", then "View order details" for this order.
The screenshot must show the order ID, the amount and the product.

{sign-off}

deliveryShotMissing.subject: Your order {order ID}: please send the delivery screenshot
deliveryShotMissing.message:
Hello {name},

This is about your order {order ID} for {product}.

The delivery screenshot was not added in the form, so we cannot see that the order was delivered.

Please reply to this email with the delivery screenshot: a screenshot of this order on Amazon that shows the word "Delivered" and the product.

How to take it:
In the Amazon app: tap "You", then "Your Orders", then this order.
On the Amazon website: click "Returns & Orders", then "View order details" for this order.
The screenshot must show the word "Delivered" and the product.

{sign-off}

reviewLinkMissing.subject: Your order {order ID}: please send the link to your review
reviewLinkMissing.message:
Hello {name},

This is about your order {order ID} for {product}.

The link to your review and the screenshot of it were not added in the form, so we cannot see your review.

Please reply to this email with the link to your own review and a screenshot of it, or with Amazon's email saying your review is live.

How to copy the link to your review:
In the Amazon app: open your review, tap "Share", then "Copy".
On the Amazon website: click the title of your review, then copy the link at the top of the page.

How to find Amazon's email about your review:
Open your email and search for "review is live". Open the email from Amazon and take a screenshot of it.

{sign-off}

cannotAddReviews.subject: Your order {order ID}: please send the message Amazon showed
cannotAddReviews.message:
Hello {name},

This is about your order {order ID} for {product}.

Amazon did not let you add a review for this product.

Please reply to this email with a screenshot of the message Amazon shows after you tap Submit. It often starts with "Error", or says Amazon is not taking reviews for this product or brand.

If you have not sent them yet, please also send the purchase screenshot and the delivery screenshot of this order.

{sign-off}
